words.en: The lowest part or edge of something, especially the part on which it rests or is supported.

words.ex: He has a scar on his arm from the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他手臂上有一道事故留下的伤疤。
words.en: A mark left on the skin after a wound or injury has healed, or the act of causing such a mark.

words.ex: The cut on his finger is bleeding.
words.ex_cn: 他手指上的伤口正在流血。
words.en: When you bleed, blood flows from your body, usually because you are injured.

words.ex: The librarian helps students find books.
words.ex_cn: 图书管理员帮助学生找书。
words.en: A librarian is a person who is in charge of a library or who has been trained to do this work.

words.tr:
v. 使用；利用；
n. 使用；用途；
words.ex: I use a pen to write.
words.ex_cn: 我用笔写字。
words.en: If you use something, you do something with it in order to do a job or to achieve a particular result or effect.

words.tr: v. 允许；留出；给予；承认；
words.ex: My parents allow me to go out on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 我的父母允许我周末外出。
words.en: If someone is allowed to do something, it is all right for them to do it and they will not get into trouble.

words.ex: He is a skilful painter who draws beautiful landscapes.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位有技巧的画家，能画出美丽的风景。
words.en: Someone who is skilful is good at doing something because they have practised it.

words.tr:
n. 最大限度；最大量；
adj. 最大极限的；最多的；
words.ex: The maximum of the crowd is 100 people.
words.ex_cn: 人群的上限是100人。
words.en: The greatest or highest amount possible or attained.

words.ex: He listens to music every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天听音乐。
words.en: If you listen to someone or something, you give your attention to a sound or to what someone says.

words.tr: adj. 令人愉快的；合意的；宜人的；
words.ex: The weather was pleasant today.
words.ex_cn: 今天的天气很令人愉快。
words.en: Something that is pleasant is enjoyable, attractive, or friendly.

words.tr: adj. 暂定的；不确定的；试验性的；
words.ex: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.ex_cn: 我们制定了一个下周见面的暂定计划。
words.en: If you make a tentative suggestion or plan, you make it without being sure that it is right or acceptable.

words.ex: He bought a leather jacket for winter.
words.ex_cn: 他冬天买了一件皮夹克。
words.en: Leather is a material made from the skin of an animal by tanning or a similar process.

words.tr:
n. 特点；特性；
adj. 典型的；特有的；
words.ex: Honesty is a key characteristic of a good friend.
words.ex_cn: 诚实是一个好朋友的关键特点。
words.en: A characteristic is a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something.

words.ex: The sun shines brightly in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 太阳在早晨明亮地发光。
words.en: To emit or reflect light brightly; to be very good at something.

words.ex: My generation grew up with smartphones.
words.ex_cn: 我们这一代人是伴随着智能手机长大的。
words.en: A generation is all the people in a group or country who are of a similar age, especially when they are considered as having the same experiences or attitudes.

words.ex: The book was dusty on the shelf.
words.ex_cn: 书在架子上积满了灰尘。
words.en: Covered with or resembling dust; dry and powdery.

words.ex: He asked for permission to leave early.
words.ex_cn: 他请求允许早点离开。
words.en: If someone who has authority over you gives you permission to do something, they say that they will allow you to do it.

words.tr:
v. 转变；转动；转弯；转身；
n. 转变；轮到的机会；
words.ex: Please turn off the light before you leave.
words.ex_cn: 请在你离开前关掉灯。
words.en: To move or cause to move in a circular direction wholly or partly around an axis or point.

words.ex: I enjoy eating ice cream on hot days.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢在热天吃冰淇淋。
words.en: If you enjoy something, you find pleasure and satisfaction in doing it or experiencing it.

words.ex: He is uncertain about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个答案不确定。
words.en: If you are uncertain about something, you do not know what is true, what is going to happen, or what you should do.

words.ex: His nature is kind and patient.
words.ex_cn: 他的本性是善良且有耐心的。
words.en: Nature refers to the physical world and everything in it that is not made by people, including plants, animals, mountains, oceans, stars, etc. It can also refer to the basic or inherent features, character, or qualities of something.

words.tr:
n. 背心；马甲；汗衫
v. 授予；使穿衣
words.ex: He wears a black vest over his shirt.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件黑色背心，上面是衬衫。
words.en: A vest is a piece of clothing without sleeves that you wear over a shirt.

words.ex: Ancient Egypt is one of the oldest civilizations.
words.ex_cn: 古埃及是最早的文明之一。
words.en: A civilization is a human society with its own social organization and culture.

words.ex: He paid with a cheque yesterday.
words.ex_cn: 他昨天用支票付款了。
words.en: A written order to a bank to pay a specified sum from someone's account.

words.tr:
v. 沐浴；用水洗；沉浸
n. 游泳
words.ex: He bathes every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上洗澡。
words.en: To bathe means to wash oneself or someone else, especially in a bath or the sea, or to spend time in water for pleasure.

words.ex: This store is convenient for buying groceries.
words.ex_cn: 这家商店买杂货很方便。
words.en: If something is convenient, it is easy to use or do, or it is useful and suitable for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The sun shone with great glory at dawn.
words.ex_cn: 黎明时分，太阳闪耀着辉煌的光辉。
words.en: High renown or honor won by notable achievements; magnificence or great beauty.

words.ex: He became angry when his phone broke.
words.ex_cn: 当他手机坏了时，他生气了。
words.en: Feeling or showing strong annoyance, displeasure, or hostility; full of anger.

words.ex: He wiped the table with a cloth.
words.ex_cn: 他用一块布擦了桌子。
words.en: To wipe something means to clean or dry it by rubbing its surface with a cloth, a piece of paper, or your hand.

words.tr: n. 奖金；红利；额外津贴；
words.ex: He received a bonus for working overtime.
words.ex_cn: 他因加班获得了奖金。
words.en: A bonus is an extra amount of money that is added to someone's pay, usually because they have worked very hard.

words.ex: The cat is sitting between the two chairs.
words.ex_cn: 猫坐在两把椅子之间。
words.en: If something is between two things or is in between them, it has one of the things on one side of it and the other thing on the other side.

words.tr:
n. 杂草；野草；
v. 除草；铲除；
words.ex: The garden is full of weeds.
words.ex_cn: 花园里长满了杂草。
words.en: A weed is a wild plant that grows in gardens or fields of crops and is not wanted because it harms the plants that are being grown.

words.ex: I saw a couple of birds flying in the sky.
words.ex_cn: 我看见几只鸟在天上飞。
words.en: A couple is two people who are married, living together, or having a sexual relationship. It can also refer to a small number of things or people.

words.ex: We will review the meeting agenda tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我们明天将审查会议议程。
words.en: An agenda is a list or plan of things to be done or considered, especially in a meeting.

words.ex: The factory's output increased last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家工厂上个月的产量增加了。
words.en: The amount of something produced by a person, machine, or industry.

words.ex: The hospital is a public institution.
words.ex_cn: 这家医院是一家公共机构。
words.en: An institution is a large important organization such as a university, church, or bank.

words.ex: People gather in the square for the festival.
words.ex_cn: 人们在广场上聚集庆祝节日。
words.en: If people gather somewhere, or if someone gathers people somewhere, they come together in a group.

words.ex: He is sceptical about the new plan.
words.ex_cn: 他对这个新计划持怀疑态度。
words.en: If you are sceptical about something, you have doubts about it.

words.tr:
adj. 典范的；典型的；
n. 文学经典；名著；优秀的典范；
words.ex: This movie is a classic comedy.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影是一部典范的喜剧。
words.en: A classic is something that is judged to be of the highest quality and outstanding of its kind.

words.ex: The movie shows too much violence.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影展示了太多的暴力。
words.en: Violence is behavior which is intended to hurt, injure, or kill people.

words.ex: I know the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我知道答案。
words.en: To have information in your mind as a result of experience or because you have learned or been told it.

words.tr: n. 毕业文凭；学位证书；
words.ex: He received his diploma last June.
words.ex_cn: 他去年六月拿到了毕业文凭。
words.en: A diploma is a document which may be awarded by a university or college, or by a high school, showing that someone has successfully completed a course of study.

words.ex: Although it was raining, he went outside.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: Despite the fact that; even though.

words.ex: Maybe it will rain tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 也许明天会下雨。
words.en: used to show that something is possible or that something might be true

words.tr:
n. 格式；
v. 格式化；
words.ex: The file is in PDF format.
words.ex_cn: 这个文件是PDF格式。
words.en: The way in which something is arranged or set out.

words.tr:
n. 两倍；
v. 加倍；是…的两倍；把…对折；
words.ex: He earned a double of his salary last month.
words.ex_cn: 他上个月赚了两倍的薪水。
words.en: If something is double, it is twice as much or twice as many. If you double something, you make it twice as much or twice as many.

words.ex: The teacher will allocate books to students.
words.ex_cn: 老师将给学生分配书籍。
words.en: To allocate something means to give it to a particular person or use it for a particular purpose.

words.tr: adj. 实用的；实际的；实践的；
words.ex: This tool is practical for everyday use.
words.ex_cn: 这个工具日常使用很实用。
words.en: relating to what is real rather than to what is possible or imagined; likely to succeed or be effective in real circumstances; involving or concerned with experience or actual use; not theoretical

words.ex: Where is the book?
words.ex_cn: 书在哪里？
words.en: You use where to ask questions about the place or position of someone or something, or to indicate the place or position of someone or something.

words.ex: The bus stops at the terminal at 9 PM.
words.ex_cn: 公交车晚上9点到达终点站。
words.en: A terminal is a place where vehicles, passengers, or goods begin or end a journey. It can also refer to a computer device at which a user enters data or commands.

words.tr: n. 车辆；交通工具；媒介；
words.ex: The vehicle stopped at the red light.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车在红灯前停了下来。
words.en: A vehicle is a machine such as a car, bus, or truck which has an engine and is used to carry people or goods from place to place.

words.tr: v. 批准；认可；通过；赞成(连of)
words.ex: My mom will approve my new phone.
words.ex_cn: 我妈妈会同意我买新手机。
words.en: If you approve of an action, event, or suggestion, you like it or are pleased about it.

words.ex: He is polite to everyone he meets.
words.ex_cn: 他对遇到的每个人都很有礼貌。
words.en: Having or showing behavior that is respectful and considerate of other people.

words.tr: adj. 使人不舒服的；不自在的；
words.ex: The chair is uncomfortable to sit on.
words.ex_cn: 这把椅子坐起来让人不舒服。
words.en: If you are uncomfortable, you are slightly worried or embarrassed, and not relaxed and confident.

words.tr:
n. 担忧；关注；
v. 涉及；
words.ex: His main concern is his child's safety.
words.ex_cn: 他主要的担忧是孩子的安全。
words.en: If something concerns you, it worries you or causes you to feel anxious.

words.tr:
adj. 壮丽的；堂皇的；重大的；总的；
n. 大钢琴；
words.ex: The grand castle stood on the hill.
words.ex_cn: 壮丽的城堡矗立在山上。
words.en: If you describe a building or a piece of scenery as grand, you mean that its size or appearance is very impressive.

words.tr:
adj. 年长的；
n. 长者；
words.ex: My elder brother works as a teacher.
words.ex_cn: 我年长的哥哥是一名老师。
words.en: An elder is a person who is older than you, especially one who is respected for their wisdom and experience.

words.ex: He read the first chapter of the book.
words.ex_cn: 他读了这本书的第一章。
words.en: A chapter is one of the parts that a book is divided into. Each chapter has a number, and sometimes a title.

words.ex: He went outside regardless of the rain.
words.ex_cn: 他不顾下雨就出去了。
words.en: If you say that someone does something regardless, you mean that they do it without taking account of the possible problems or difficulties.

words.ex: He stepped on my heel by accident.
words.ex_cn: 他不小心踩到了我的脚后跟。
words.en: The heel is the back part of the foot, below the ankle. It can also refer to the part of a shoe or boot that supports this part of the foot.

words.tr:
prep. 在…下面；低于；少于；
adv. 在下面；
words.ex: The cat is below the table.
words.ex_cn: 猫在桌子下面。
words.en: If something is below something else, it is in a lower position.

words.tr: adj. 流行的；受欢迎的；大众的；
words.ex: This song is popular among teenagers.
words.ex_cn: 这首歌在青少年中很流行。
words.en: liked, admired, or enjoyed by many people or by a particular person or group

words.tr: n. 代理；副职；恶习；缺点；
words.ex: He acted as vice for the manager during her absence.
words.ex_cn: 在经理缺席期间，他担任代理。
words.en: A vice is a moral fault or weakness in someone's character.

words.ex: He was rude to the waiter.
words.ex_cn: 他对服务员很无礼。
words.en: If someone is rude, they behave in a way that is not polite and upsets other people.

words.tr: adj. 不同的；多种多样的；
words.ex: The class has diverse students from many countries.
words.ex_cn: 这个班级有来自许多国家的不同学生。
words.en: If a group or range of things is diverse, it is made up of a wide variety of things.

words.ex: He refused to eat the broccoli.
words.ex_cn: 他拒绝吃西兰花。
words.en: If you refuse to do something, you deliberately do not do it, or you say firmly that you will not do it.

words.ex: He blew a whistle to get our attention.
words.ex_cn: 他吹了一声口哨来引起我们的注意。
words.en: A whistle is a small metal tube which you blow in order to produce a loud sound and attract someone's attention. A whistle is also the sound that you make when you blow a whistle or when you whistle.

words.tr:
n. 文件；公文；文献；
v. 记录；为…提供证明；
words.ex: He submitted the document to the office.
words.ex_cn: 他把文件提交给了办公室。
words.en: A document is a piece of text or graphics, for example a letter, that is stored as a file on a computer and that you can access in order to read it or change it.

words.ex: His competence in math helped him solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他在数学方面的能力帮助他解决了这个问题。
words.en: Competence is the ability to do something well or efficiently.

words.tr:
v. 禁止；
n. 禁止；
words.ex: The school bans phones in class.
words.ex_cn: 学校禁止在课堂上使用手机。
words.en: If there is a ban on something, it is not allowed. If something is banned, it is not allowed to be done, shown, or used.

words.tr:
v. 意思；导致；打算；
n. 平均数；
adj. 低劣；平均；
words.ex: What does this word mean?
words.ex_cn: 这个词是什么意思？
words.en: If you want to know what a word, a sentence, or an expression means, you want to know what it refers to or what its significance is.

words.ex: He accumulates coins from different countries.
words.ex_cn: 他收集来自不同国家的硬币。
words.en: To accumulate means to gradually gather or acquire an increasing number or quantity of something.

words.tr: v. 辞职；使…顺从于（做）某事；
words.ex: He decided to resign from his job.
words.ex_cn: 他决定辞去工作。
words.en: If you resign from a job or position, you formally announce that you are leaving it.

words.ex: The urban area has many tall buildings.
words.ex_cn: 这个城市地区有许多高楼。
words.en: relating to a city or town

words.tr:
n. 混合；结合；
v. 混合；掺入；合成；交往；
words.ex: The recipe calls for a mix of flour and sugar.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱需要一种面粉和糖的混合物。
words.en: To combine two or more substances so that they become a single substance, or to be combined in this way.

words.tr: adj. 一致的；始终如一的；
words.ex: His answers are consistent with the data.
words.ex_cn: 他的答案与数据一致。
words.en: Someone who is consistent always behaves in the same way, has the same attitudes towards people or things, or achieves the same level of success in something.

words.tr:
adj. 主要的；首要的；
n. 领袖；首领；
words.ex: He is the chief reason for the team's success.
words.ex_cn: 他是球队成功的主要原因。
words.en: The chief is the leader of a group or organization, or the main part of something.

words.ex: He is learning biochemistry at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习生物化学。
words.en: The branch of science concerned with the chemical processes occurring within living organisms.

words.tr:
n. 修理；修补；
v. 修理；修补；
words.ex: The repair of the car took two days.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车的修理花了两天时间。
words.en: To repair something that is damaged or not working properly means to fix it.

words.tr:
adv. 全球性地；
adj. 全球性的；
words.ex: The news spread worldwide overnight.
words.ex_cn: 这则新闻一夜之间传遍全球。
words.en: Something that is worldwide exists or happens in all parts of the world.

words.ex: They will rebuild the house after the storm.
words.ex_cn: 他们将在风暴后重建这座房子。
words.en: To rebuild something means to build it again after it has been damaged or destroyed.

words.ex: He greet his friend with a smile.
words.ex_cn: 他微笑着向朋友问好。
words.en: To greet someone means to say hello to them or to welcome them.

words.ex: He lost his fortune in the stock market.
words.ex_cn: 他在股市中失去了他的财产。
words.en: A large amount of money or assets; chance or luck as an external force in human affairs.

words.tr:
v. 保证；确保；
n. 保证；保证书；
words.ex: The store guarantees a refund if you are not happy.
words.ex_cn: 如果你不满意，商店保证退款。
words.en: A guarantee is a formal promise that certain conditions will be fulfilled, especially that a product will be repaired or replaced if it is not of a specified quality.

words.ex: The restaurant caters to vegetarians.
words.ex_cn: 这家餐厅满足素食者的需求。
words.en: To cater means to provide food and drink at an event, often as a business service, or to provide what is needed or wanted by a particular person or group.

words.tr:
adj. 简短的；简明的；短暂的；
v. 为…提供信息；
n. 摘要；概要；
words.ex: He gave a brief answer.
words.ex_cn: 他给出了一个简短的答案。
words.en: If something is brief, it lasts only for a short time.

words.ex: I advise you to eat more vegetables.
words.ex_cn: 我建议你多吃蔬菜。
words.en: If you advise someone to do something, you tell them what you think they should do.

words.tr:
n. 混凝土；
adj. 具体的；
words.ex: The workers poured concrete to build the foundation.
words.ex_cn: 工人们浇筑混凝土来建造地基。
words.en: Concrete is a hard, strong construction material made by mixing a cementing material (such as Portland cement) and a mineral aggregate (such as sand and gravel) with sufficient water to cause the cement to set and bind the entire mass. In a broader sense, concrete can also refer to something that is tangible, specific, or real.

words.tr: n. 养老金；退休金；抚恤金；
words.ex: He receives a monthly pension after retiring.
words.ex_cn: 他退休后每月领取养老金。
words.en: A pension is a sum of money which a retired, widowed, or disabled person regularly receives from the state or from a former employer.

words.tr:
n. 冲；匆忙；
v. 冲；赶忙做；
words.ex: There was a rush to buy tickets for the concert.
words.ex_cn: 人们争相购买演唱会的票。
words.en: If you rush somewhere, you go there quickly. A rush is a situation in which you need to go somewhere or do something very quickly.

words.ex: He walked alongside the river.
words.ex_cn: 他沿着河边走。
words.en: If one thing is alongside another thing, the first thing is next to the second.

words.ex: He eats apples every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天吃苹果。
words.en: Each and all of the members of a group or set without exception.

words.tr:
n. 救援；营救；
v. 救援；营救；
words.ex: The rescue came just in time to save the hikers.
words.ex_cn: 救援及时赶到，救出了徒步者。
words.en: To rescue someone or something means to save them from a dangerous or unpleasant situation.

words.ex: He asks me a question every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天问我一个问题。
words.en: If you ask someone something, you say something to them in the form of a question because you want to know the answer.

words.ex: The box has a rectangle shape.
words.ex_cn: 这个盒子是长方形的。
words.en: A rectangle is a four-sided flat shape where every interior angle is a right angle (90°). Opposite sides are parallel and of equal length.

words.ex: She made dumplings for dinner.
words.ex_cn: 她为晚餐包了饺子。
words.en: A small lump of dough that is cooked and served with a meal, often as a side dish.

words.tr:
n. 轮廓；纲要；
v. 描画轮廓；概述；
words.ex: The artist drew the outline of the mountain.
words.ex_cn: 艺术家画出了山的轮廓。
words.en: An outline is a line that shows or forms the outer edge of something, or a general description or plan showing the essential features of something but not the detail.

words.ex: The trend shows more people are using electric cars.
words.ex_cn: 这个趋势表明越来越多的人在使用电动汽车。
words.en: A trend is a general development or change in a situation or in the way that people are behaving.

words.ex: They communicate well with each other.
words.ex_cn: 他们彼此沟通得很好。
words.en: To communicate means to share or exchange information, news, or ideas, especially by speaking or writing.

words.ex: The child screamed when she saw the dog.
words.ex_cn: 当那个孩子看到狗时，她尖叫了起来。
words.en: If you scream, you shout or cry in a loud high-pitched voice, usually because you are in pain or are very frightened.

words.ex: He is merely a student.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅是个学生。
words.en: You use merely to emphasize that something is only what you say and not better, more important, or more exciting.

words.tr: adj. 无聊的；烦闷的；厌倦的； v. 钻孔；“bore”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He felt bored during the long meeting.
words.ex_cn: 他在漫长的会议中感到无聊。
words.en: If you are bored, you feel tired and impatient because you have lost interest in something or because you have nothing to do.

words.ex: He is chewing gum loudly.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大声地嚼口香糖。
words.en: To chew means to bite and grind food in your mouth so it becomes soft enough to swallow.

words.tr:
n. 弹跳；跳动；
v. 弹跳；反弹；
words.ex: The ball had a high bounce on the concrete.
words.ex_cn: 球在混凝土上弹跳得很高。
words.en: If something bounces or if you bounce it, it moves away from a surface after hitting it.

words.tr:
n. 表；名单；
v. 列出；
words.ex: He wrote his name on the list.
words.ex_cn: 他把自己的名字写在了表上。
words.en: A list is a set of items, especially names, written or printed one after the other.

words.tr: adj. 可选择的；非强制的；
words.ex: The field trip is optional.
words.ex_cn: 这次郊游是可选的。
words.en: If something is optional, you can choose whether or not you do it or have it.

words.ex: The company will advertise its new phone on TV.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司将在电视上为新手机登广告。
words.en: If you advertise something such as a product, an event, or a job, you tell people about it in newspapers, on television, or on posters in order to encourage them to buy the product, go to the event, or apply for the job.

words.ex: The blind man walks with a white cane.
words.ex_cn: 这位失明的男人用白色手杖走路。
words.en: Unable to see; lacking the sense of sight.

words.ex: His status in the company is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他在公司里的地位很高。
words.en: The status of someone or something is their position or situation according to the law or according to other people's opinions.

words.ex: I download music from the internet.
words.ex_cn: 我从互联网下载音乐。
words.en: To download data means to transfer it to your computer or device from another computer or from the internet.

words.ex: He sat beside his friend on the bus.
words.ex_cn: 他坐在朋友旁边。
words.en: At the side of; next to.

words.tr:
n. 火；
v. 射击；开火；
words.ex: The fire burned brightly in the fireplace.
words.ex_cn: 火在壁炉里熊熊燃烧。
words.en: Fire is the heat and light that comes out when something burns. It can also refer to the act of shooting a weapon or the dismissal of an employee from a job.

words.ex: He is learning theoretical physics at university.
words.ex_cn: 他正在大学学习理论物理。
words.en: A theoretical study or explanation is based on or uses the ideas and abstract principles of a subject, rather than the practical aspects or uses of it.

words.ex: He is greedy and always wants more candy.
words.ex_cn: 他很贪婪，总是想要更多的糖果。
words.en: If you describe someone as greedy, you mean that they want to have more of something such as food or money than is necessary or fair.

words.ex: Wearing a helmet can prevent head injuries.
words.ex_cn: 戴头盔可以防止头部受伤。
words.en: To prevent something means to stop it from happening or to stop someone from doing something.

words.tr: adj. 不平常的；不寻常的；
words.ex: It is unusual to see snow in this city.
words.ex_cn: 在这个城市看到雪是不平常的。
words.en: If something is unusual, it does not happen very often or you do not see it or hear it very often.

words.ex: The recipe is perfect for beginners.
words.ex_cn: 这个食谱对初学者来说是完备的。
words.en: Something that is perfect is as good as it could possibly be.

words.tr: adj. 无意识的；无知觉的；
words.ex: He was unconscious after the accident.
words.ex_cn: 事故发生后，他失去了意识。
words.en: If someone is unconscious, they are not awake, usually because they have had a severe injury or illness.

words.tr:
n. 问题；疑问；
v. 怀疑；询问；
words.ex: He asked a simple question in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上问了一个简单的问题。
words.en: A sentence or phrase used to find out information.

words.ex: Dinosaurs existed millions of years ago.
words.ex_cn: 恐龙存在于数百万年前。
words.en: If something exists, it is present in the world as a real thing.

words.ex: His wisdom helped the team solve the problem.
words.ex_cn: 他的智慧帮助团队解决了问题。
words.en: Wisdom is the ability to use your knowledge and experience to make good decisions and judgments.

words.tr: adj. 国内的；公民的；民用的；
words.ex: The country is recovering from a civil war.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在从一场内战中恢复。
words.en: relating to ordinary citizens and their concerns, as distinct from military or ecclesiastical matters.

words.ex: I send a message to my friend.
words.ex_cn: 我给朋友发送一条消息。
words.en: To cause to go or be taken to a particular destination; dispatch.

words.tr:
n. 流动；
v. 流动；
words.ex: The flow of water in the river is very fast.
words.ex_cn: 河里水的流动非常快。
words.en: To move along or out steadily and continuously in a current or stream.

words.tr:
adj. 平静的；镇静的；
v. （使）平静；（使）镇定；
n. 平静；
words.ex: The lake was calm in the morning.
words.ex_cn: 早晨的湖面很平静。
words.en: If someone is calm, they are not excited, anxious, or upset, but are rational and composed.

words.ex: A passer-by helped the old man cross the street.
words.ex_cn: 一位路人帮老人过马路。
words.en: A passer-by is a person who is walking past something, especially when something unusual is happening.

words.ex: He hardly ate anything at dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚餐几乎没吃东西。
words.en: You use hardly to modify a statement when you want to emphasize that it is only a small amount or degree which is true, or that it is not true at all.

words.tr: adj. 失望的；沮丧的； v. “disappoint”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was disappointed when he failed the test.
words.ex_cn: 他考试没及格时感到很失望。
words.en: If you are disappointed, you are sad because something has not happened or because something is not as good as you had hoped.

words.ex: I hate waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 我讨厌早起。
words.en: To hate someone or something means to feel intense or passionate dislike for them.

words.ex: I met him at a party, but he is only an acquaintance.
words.ex_cn: 我在聚会上认识了他，但他只是个熟人。
words.en: An acquaintance is someone you know a little, who is not a close friend.

words.ex: She gave him a sweet kiss goodnight.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他一个甜蜜的晚安之吻。
words.en: To touch or press your lips against someone or something as a sign of love or affection.

words.ex: He got a patent for his new invention.
words.ex_cn: 他为自己的新发明获得了专利。
words.en: A patent is an official right to be the only person or company allowed to make or sell a new product for a certain period of time.

words.tr:
n. 抓痕；刮伤；
v. 抓搔；刮；
words.ex: The cat left a scratch on the door.
words.ex_cn: 猫在门上抓出了一道抓痕。
words.en: If you scratch something, you rub your fingernails or claws against it, often because it is itchy or irritating.

words.tr:
n. 要点；点；观点；分数；
v. 指出；指向；
words.ex: The main point of his speech was to save energy.
words.ex_cn: 他演讲的主要要点是节约能源。
words.en: A point is a particular place or position, or a detail or aspect of something. It can also refer to the sharp end of something, or a unit of scoring in games. As a verb, it means to direct someone's attention towards something by extending a finger or other object.

words.tr: adj. 无条件的；无限制的；绝对的
words.ex: She gave him unconditional love.
words.ex_cn: 她给了他无条件的爱。
words.en: If you describe something as unconditional, you mean that it is not limited or affected by any conditions.

words.ex: He is a famous singer.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位著名的歌手。
words.en: Known about by many people.

words.tr:
n. 兴趣；利息；利益；
v. 使产生兴趣；
words.ex: He has a strong interest in painting.
words.ex_cn: 他对绘画有浓厚的兴趣。
words.en: If you have an interest in something, you want to learn or hear more about it.

words.ex: This village is the birthplace of the famous poet.
words.ex_cn: 这个村庄是这位著名诗人的发源地。
words.en: The place where someone was born.

words.ex: He read the story aloud to his little sister.
words.ex_cn: 他大声给小妹妹读这个故事。
words.en: If you say something aloud, you say it in a normal speaking voice, rather than whispering or thinking it.

words.tr:
int. 欢迎；
v. 欢迎；
adj. 受欢迎的；
n. 欢迎；
words.ex: Welcome to our school!
words.ex_cn: 欢迎来到我们的学校！
words.en: If you welcome someone, you greet them in a friendly way when they arrive somewhere.

words.ex: His recipe for success is hard work and patience.
words.ex_cn: 他成功的秘诀是努力工作和耐心。
words.en: A recipe is a list of ingredients and a set of instructions that tell you how to cook something.

words.tr:
conj. 虽然；尽管；然而；
adv. 虽然；尽管；可是；
words.ex: Though it was raining, he went out.
words.ex_cn: 虽然天下雨了，他还是出去了。
words.en: You use though to introduce a statement in a subordinate clause which contrasts with the statement in the main clause. You often use though to introduce a fact which you regard as less important than the fact in the main clause.

words.ex: The Tang dynasty was famous for its poetry and art.
words.ex_cn: 唐朝以诗歌和艺术而闻名。
words.en: A dynasty is a series of rulers of a country who all belong to the same family.

words.ex: He used an idiom to explain his idea.
words.ex_cn: 他用了一个成语来解释他的想法。
words.en: An idiom is a group of words in a fixed order that have a particular meaning that is different from the meanings of each word on its own.

words.tr:
n. 业余爱好者；
adj. 业余的；
words.ex: He is an amateur who paints on weekends.
words.ex_cn: 他是个周末画画的业余爱好者。
words.en: An amateur is someone who does something as a hobby and not as a job.

words.ex: He tried to resist the temptation to eat sweets.
words.ex_cn: 他试图抵制吃甜食的诱惑。
words.en: If you resist something such as a change, you refuse to accept it and try to prevent it.

words.ex: He improved his vocabulary by reading every day.
words.ex_cn: 他通过每天阅读来提高自己的词汇量。
words.en: The vocabulary of a person is all the words that they know or use in a particular language.

words.ex: My teacher is strict about homework deadlines.
words.ex_cn: 我的老师对作业截止日期要求很严格。
words.en: If someone is strict, they behave firmly and make sure that rules are obeyed.

words.ex: He kept the receipt for his new shoes.
words.ex_cn: 他保留了新鞋的收据。
words.en: A receipt is a piece of paper that you get from someone as proof that they have received money or goods from you.

words.ex: We had a short conversation about the weather.
words.ex_cn: 我们简短地聊了聊天气。
words.en: A conversation is a talk between two or more people, in which news and ideas are exchanged.

words.ex: He picked up a brochure about the city.
words.ex_cn: 他拿了一本关于这座城市的宣传小册子。
words.en: A brochure is a type of small magazine or booklet containing pictures and information about something or advertising something.

words.tr:
adj. 下一个的；
adv. 随后；
pron. 下一个；
words.ex: This is the next bus to the city.
words.ex_cn: 这是下一班去城市的公交车。
words.en: Coming immediately after the present one in order, sequence, or time.

words.tr:
n. 离婚；
v. 和…离婚；
words.ex: They filed for divorce after ten years of marriage.
words.ex_cn: 他们结婚十年后申请了离婚。
words.en: Divorce is the formal ending of a marriage by law.

words.ex: The constitution protects the rights of all citizens.
words.ex_cn: 宪法保护所有公民的权利。
words.en: The constitution of a country or organization is the system of laws which formally states people's rights and duties.

words.ex: The basis of math is numbers.
words.ex_cn: 数学的基础是数字。
words.en: The underlying support or foundation for an idea, argument, or process.

words.ex: I have math lesson every Monday.
words.ex_cn: 我每周一都有数学课。
words.en: A lesson is a period of time in which someone is taught about a particular subject or how to do something.

words.ex: He uses software to write his homework.
words.ex_cn: 他使用软件写作业。
words.en: Software refers to the programs and other operating information used by a computer.

words.ex: There is friction between the two neighbors over the fence.
words.ex_cn: 两个邻居因为篱笆问题产生了不和。
words.en: The resistance that one surface or object encounters when moving over another.

words.tr:
v. 提到；说到；
n. 提及；说起；
words.ex: He didn't mention the accident.
words.ex_cn: 他没有提到那场事故。
words.en: If you mention something, you say something about it, usually briefly.

words.tr: adj. 荒唐的；荒唐可笑的；
words.ex: It's absurd to wear a coat in summer.
words.ex_cn: 夏天穿外套是荒唐的。
words.en: If you say that something is absurd, you are criticizing it because you think that it is ridiculous or that it does not make sense.

words.tr:
n. 后者（the ~）；
adj. 后期的；后面的；
words.ex: I like tea and coffee; I prefer the latter.
words.ex_cn: 我喜欢茶和咖啡；我更喜欢后者。
words.en: The latter is used to refer to the second of two things or people mentioned.

words.tr:
v. 耳语；低语
n. 耳语；低语；沙沙的声音
words.ex: He whispered a secret to his friend.
words.ex_cn: 他向朋友低语了一个秘密。
words.en: To speak very quietly using one's breath rather than one's throat, especially for the sake of privacy.

words.ex: He has a large house.
words.ex_cn: 他有一所大房子。
words.en: Something that is large is greater in size than usual or average.

words.ex: He gave a quick preview of the movie.
words.ex_cn: 他简要预看了这部电影。
words.en: A preview is an opportunity to see something such as a film or a collection of works of art before it is open to the public.

words.ex: The theft of the bike was reported to the police.
words.ex_cn: 这起自行车被盗事件已向警方报告。
words.en: Theft is the act of stealing.

words.tr:
n. 水平；程度；等级；
adj. 平齐的；
v. 使平坦；
words.ex: His English level is very high.
words.ex_cn: 他的英语水平很高。
words.en: A level is a point on a scale, for example a scale of amount, quality, or difficulty.

words.tr: adj. 习惯的；惯常的； v. “accustom”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He is accustomed to waking up early.
words.ex_cn: 他习惯早起。
words.en: If you are accustomed to something, you know it so well or have experienced it so often that it seems natural, unsurprising, or easy to deal with.

words.ex: He sent the document by fax.
words.ex_cn: 他通过传真发送了文件。
words.en: A fax is a machine that sends and receives documents electronically along a telephone line, or a document that is sent or received using such a machine.

words.ex: The archer drew the bow and shot the arrow.
words.ex_cn: 弓箭手拉弓射出了箭。
words.en: A bow is a knot with two loops and two loose ends that is used in tying shoelaces and decorative ribbons. It is also the front part of a ship or boat.

words.tr: adj. 典型的；有代表性的；
words.ex: This is a typical example of a sunny day.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个晴天的典型例子。
words.en: You use typical to describe someone or something that shows the most usual characteristics of a particular type of person or thing, and is therefore a good example of that type.

words.ex: The water freezes at zero centigrade.
words.ex_cn: 水在零摄氏度时结冰。
words.en: Centigrade is a scale for measuring temperature, in which water freezes at 0 degrees and boils at 100 degrees.

words.ex: The editor corrected the grammar in the article.
words.ex_cn: 编辑纠正了这篇文章的语法。
words.en: An editor is a person who is in charge of a newspaper or magazine and who decides what will be published in it.

words.ex: The country is developing its economy.
words.ex_cn: 这个国家正在发展它的经济。
words.en: To develop means to grow or cause to grow and become more mature, advanced, or elaborate.

words.tr:
n. 漏洞；泄露；
v. 漏；泄露；
words.ex: The leak in the roof caused water to drip inside.
words.ex_cn: 屋顶的漏洞导致水滴进屋里。
words.en: If a container or pipe leaks, or if it leaks a substance such as liquid or gas, the substance comes out of it accidentally because there is a hole or crack in it.

words.tr: n. 一段时间；会议；会期；开庭；学年；
words.ex: We had a long session of studying together.
words.ex_cn: 我们一起学习了一段时间。
words.en: A session is a meeting of a court, parliament, or other official group, or a period of time used for a particular activity, especially by a group of people.

words.tr:
n. 结束；尽头；目标；末端；
v. 结束；终止；
words.ex: The end of the movie made everyone cry.
words.ex_cn: 电影的结尾让所有人都哭了。
words.en: The end of something such as a period of time, an event, a book, or a film is the last part of it or the point at which it stops.

words.tr:
n. 平衡；天平；秤；
v. （使）相抵；（使）平衡；
words.ex: She maintains a good balance between work and rest.
words.ex_cn: 她在工作和休息之间保持良好的平衡。
words.en: Balance is the ability to remain steady when you are standing up. Also, it refers to the state of having your weight spread equally so that you do not fall. In finance, it refers to the amount of money you have in a bank account.

words.tr: adj. 令人厌恶的；令人作呕的； v. “disgust”的现在分词；
words.ex: The smell of the rotten food was disgusting.
words.ex_cn: 腐烂食物的气味令人厌恶。
words.en: If you say that something is disgusting, you mean that you find it completely unacceptable or unpleasant.

words.ex: He got an injury while playing soccer.
words.ex_cn: 他在踢足球时受了伤。
words.en: An injury is damage to your body. It is a general term that refers to harm caused by accidents, falls, hits, weapons, etc.

words.ex: He went on an adventure in the jungle.
words.ex_cn: 他去丛林里冒险。
words.en: An adventure is an exciting experience or undertaking that is typically bold, sometimes risky.

words.tr:
n. 自豪；骄傲；
v. 对…感到自豪；
words.ex: He felt pride when his son graduated.
words.ex_cn: 当他儿子毕业时，他感到自豪。
words.en: A feeling of deep pleasure or satisfaction derived from one's own achievements, the achievements of those with whom one is closely associated, or from qualities or possessions that are widely admired.

words.ex: He speaks English with great fluency.
words.ex_cn: 他英语说得很流利。
words.en: Fluency is the ability to speak or write a language easily and well.

words.tr: n. 条状物；酒吧；栅栏；棒；
words.ex: He ate a chocolate bar after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他晚饭后吃了一条巧克力。
words.en: A bar is a place where alcoholic drinks are served, or a long, narrow piece of metal or wood used for a particular purpose.

words.ex: The workers used a drill to make holes in the rock.
words.ex_cn: 工人们用钻机在岩石上打孔。
words.en: A drill is a tool or machine that you use for making holes, or a method of teaching people something by making them repeat it many times.

words.ex: The school decided to adopt a new teaching method.
words.ex_cn: 学校决定采纳一种新的教学方法。
words.en: To adopt means to take up or start to use or follow (an idea, method, or course of action). It can also mean to legally take another's child and bring it up as one's own.

words.ex: There was a dip in sales last month.
words.ex_cn: 上个月销售额有所下降。
words.en: To dip something means to put it into a liquid and then take it out again.

words.ex: The teacher gave extra praise to satisfy the students.
words.ex_cn: 老师给予额外的表扬来使学生满意。
words.en: If someone or something satisfies you, they give you enough of what you want or need to make you pleased or contented.

words.tr:
n. 疑问；疑惑；
v. 怀疑；拿不准；
words.ex: I have doubt about the answer.
words.ex_cn: 我对这个答案有疑问。
words.en: If you have doubt or doubts about something, you feel uncertain about it and do not know whether it is true or possible. If you say that something is beyond doubt, you mean that it is definitely true.

words.ex: I appreciate the beauty of nature.
words.ex_cn: 我欣赏大自然的美。
words.en: If you appreciate something, you recognize its value and feel grateful for it.

words.tr:
adj. 零下的；负的；
n. 缺点；
prep. 减去；
words.ex: The temperature is minus ten degrees Celsius.
words.ex_cn: 气温是零下十摄氏度。
words.en: A minus is a mathematical symbol that represents subtraction or a negative quantity.

words.tr:
n. 主题；学科；对象；
v. 使臣服；
adj. 易遭受…的；受…支配的；
words.ex: The subject of the book is ancient history.
words.ex_cn: 这本书的主题是古代历史。
words.en: A subject is something that is discussed, studied, or written about. It can also refer to a person or thing that is the focus of attention or action. In grammar, a subject is the part of a sentence that performs the action of the verb.

words.tr: n. 获得；得到的东西；收购；
words.ex: The acquisition of new skills takes time.
words.ex_cn: 获得新技能需要时间。
words.en: An acquisition is something that someone buys, often to add to a collection of things.

words.tr:
n. 控制；管制；
v. 控制；操纵；
words.ex: The teacher has good control of the class.
words.ex_cn: 老师对课堂有很好的控制。
words.en: To control something means to have power over it and to be able to make it do what you want.

words.tr:
n. 远足；郊游；短途旅行
v. 使熄灭；揭露；驱逐；“out”的现在分词
words.ex: We went on a school outing last weekend.
words.ex_cn: 上周末我们去学校组织的郊游了。
words.en: An outing is a short trip that you go on for pleasure or education, often with a group of people.

words.ex: He sells apples at the market.
words.ex_cn: 他在市场上卖苹果。
words.en: To give or hand over (something) in exchange for money.

words.ex: The job position is still vacant.
words.ex_cn: 这个职位仍然空缺。
words.en: If something is vacant, it is not being used by anyone.

words.tr:
n. 地方；方位；
v. 安放；安置；
words.ex: This is a quiet place to read books.
words.ex_cn: 这是一个安静的地方读书。
words.en: A particular position or point in space.

words.ex: Rock contains many minerals.
words.ex_cn: 岩石中含有许多矿物。
words.en: A mineral is a solid substance that occurs naturally and has a specific chemical composition and structure.

words.tr: adj. 能够；能…的；有能力的；
words.ex: He is able to swim across the river.
words.ex_cn: 他能够游过这条河。
words.en: If you are able to do something, you have the skills, strength, knowledge, or other qualities needed to do it.

words.ex: He practices gymnastics every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上练习体操。
words.en: Gymnastics is a sport that involves exercises and movements that require physical strength, flexibility, balance, and control.

words.ex: I nearly missed the bus this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上差点没赶上公交车。
words.en: Almost, but not quite; very close to.

words.ex: He practices his religion every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都实践自己的宗教信仰。
words.en: Religion is the belief in and worship of a superhuman controlling power, especially a personal God or gods.

words.tr:
v. 摔跤；扭斗；奋力对付
n. 摔跤；角力；扭斗
words.ex: He tries to wrestle the dog away from the trash.
words.ex_cn: 他试图把狗从垃圾桶旁拉开。
words.en: To engage in a physical contest, typically involving grappling and trying to throw or immobilize the opponent, or to struggle with a difficult problem or decision.

words.ex: The town is near the frontier of the country.
words.ex_cn: 这个小镇靠近国家的边境。
words.en: A frontier is a border between two countries or the area close to it. It can also refer to the limit of knowledge or the most advanced or recent stage in the development of something.

words.ex: Water is vital for life.
words.ex_cn: 水对生命至关重要。
words.en: If you say that something is vital, you mean that it is necessary or very important.

words.tr:
adj. 本土的；
n. 土著；本地人；
words.ex: This plant is native to Australia.
words.ex_cn: 这种植物原产于澳大利亚。
words.en: A native of a particular country or region is someone who was born in that country or region.

words.ex: He attended a seminar on climate change.
words.ex_cn: 他参加了一个关于气候变化的研讨会。
words.en: A seminar is a meeting where a group of people discuss a problem or topic.

words.ex: He picked up the parcel from the post office.
words.ex_cn: 他从邮局取了包裹。
words.en: A parcel is something wrapped in paper, usually so that it can be sent to someone by post.

words.tr:
n. 材料；原料；
adj. 物质的；
words.ex: The table is made of wood material.
words.ex_cn: 这张桌子是由木头材料制成的。
words.en: Material refers to the substance or substances from which a thing is made or can be made, or information or ideas for use in creating a book or other work.

words.ex: The volcano erupted last year.
words.ex_cn: 这座火山去年喷发了。
words.en: A volcano is a mountain that opens downward to a pool of molten rock below the surface of the earth. When pressure builds up, eruptions occur.

words.ex: He is likely to win the game.
words.ex_cn: 他很可能赢得比赛。
words.en: If something is likely, it will probably happen or is expected.

words.ex: The water in the pond is cloudy.
words.ex_cn: 池塘里的水很浑浊。
words.en: If it is cloudy, there are a lot of clouds in the sky.

words.ex: The school has a new grading system.
words.ex_cn: 学校有一个新的评分系统。
words.en: A system is a group of interacting or interrelated entities that form a unified whole.

words.tr:
adj. 动态的；有活力的；不断变化的；
n. 活力；动力；
words.ex: The game has dynamic weather that changes every hour.
words.ex_cn: 这个游戏有每小时变化的动态天气。
words.en: If you describe someone as dynamic, you approve of them because they are full of energy or full of new ideas.

words.tr:
adj. 晚的；迟的；已故的；
adv. 晚；迟；
words.ex: The train is late.
words.ex_cn: 火车晚点了。
words.en: After the expected, usual, or proper time.

words.ex: The ambulance arrived quickly to help the injured man.
words.ex_cn: 救护车迅速到达以帮助受伤的男人。
words.en: An ambulance is a vehicle equipped to transport the sick or injured, especially to a hospital.

words.ex: He is an interpreter for the United Nations.
words.ex_cn: 他是联合国的口译员。
words.en: An interpreter is a person whose job is to translate what someone is saying into another language, especially in a situation where people are speaking different languages.

words.ex: Everybody likes ice cream.
words.ex_cn: 每个人喜欢冰淇淋。
words.en: Every person; everyone.

words.tr:
n. 海港；
v. 庇护；窝藏；
words.ex: The ship docked at the harbour at sunset.
words.ex_cn: 船在日落时停靠在海港。
words.en: A harbour is an area of water next to the coast where ships and boats can shelter.

words.ex: He fell and hurt his knee.
words.ex_cn: 他摔倒了，伤了膝盖。
words.en: The knee is the joint between the thigh and the lower leg in humans.

words.tr:
v. 交谈；说话；
n. 谈话；
words.ex: They talk every evening after dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他们每天晚饭后都会交谈。
words.en: To speak in order to give information or express ideas or feelings; conversation or discussion.

words.tr:
prep. 在…之前；先于；
conj. 在…以前；
adv. 以前；之前；
words.ex: She ate breakfast before school.
words.ex_cn: 她在上学之前吃了早餐。
words.en: Earlier in time; previously.

words.ex: Many people face unemployment during the economic crisis.
words.ex_cn: 在经济危机期间，许多人面临失业。
words.en: Unemployment refers to the state of being without a job, especially when one is actively seeking employment.

words.ex: He took a temporary job during summer.
words.ex_cn: 他在暑假期间做了一份短暂的工作。
words.en: Something that is temporary lasts for only a limited time.

words.tr:
n. 情节；小块用地；
v. 绘图；
words.ex: The plot of the movie was very exciting.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影的情节非常精彩。
words.en: A plot is a secret plan by a group of people to do something that is illegal or wrong, especially against a person or a government. It can also refer to the main events of a play, novel, movie, or similar work, devised and presented by the writer as an interrelated sequence. Additionally, a plot can be a small piece of land that is used or intended for a specific purpose.

words.tr:
n. 剩余部分；其他；休息；
v. （使）休息；（使）倚靠；停留在；
words.ex: He ate the first slice and left the rest for his sister.
words.ex_cn: 他吃了第一块，把剩下的留给了他妹妹。
words.en: To rest means to cease work or movement in order to relax, sleep, or recover strength. It can also refer to the remaining part of something.

words.ex: The desert seems endless.
words.ex_cn: 这片沙漠看起来无穷无尽。
words.en: If you say that something is endless, you mean that it is very large or lasts for a very long time, and it seems as if it will never stop.

words.ex: The bride walked slowly down the aisle.
words.ex_cn: 新娘缓缓走过过道。
words.en: A bride is a woman who is getting married or who has just got married.

words.ex: The mother grooms her puppy every morning.
words.ex_cn: 妈妈每天早上给她的小狗梳理毛发。
words.en: A groom is a man who is getting married. Also, to groom means to clean and brush an animal, or to prepare someone for a particular job or position.

words.tr:
v. 担心；担忧；
n. 担心；忧虑；
words.ex: She worries about her son every day.
words.ex_cn: 她每天为她的儿子担心。
words.en: If you worry, you keep thinking about problems that you have or about unpleasant things that might happen.

words.tr: adj. 直言无讳的；坦率的；
words.ex: He is an outspoken teacher who always tells the truth.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位直言不讳的老师，总是说真话。
words.en: Someone who is outspoken expresses their opinions frankly and honestly, even if they are likely to shock or offend people.

words.tr:
adj. （职位或等级）较低的；年幼的；（高中、大学的）三年级学生；
n. 年幼者；
words.ex: He is a junior employee in the company.
words.ex_cn: 他是公司里职位较低的员工。
words.en: A junior person is younger or has a lower position than another person.

words.ex: He did voluntary work at the hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他在医院做志愿工作。
words.en: If something is voluntary, you do it because you choose to, and not because you have to.

words.ex: The dialogue in the movie was very funny.
words.ex_cn: 这部电影中的对白非常幽默。
words.en: A dialogue is a conversation between two or more people in a book, play, or film.

words.ex: I envy her for her happy family.
words.ex_cn: 我羡慕她幸福的家庭。
words.en: Envy is the feeling you have when you wish you could have the same thing or quality that someone else has.

words.ex: The fish swim among the seaweed near the shore.
words.ex_cn: 鱼在岸边的海藻间游动。
words.en: Seaweed is a plant that grows in the sea, especially in the ocean. It is often used in food, medicine, and cosmetics.

words.ex: Everything is ready for the party.
words.ex_cn: 派对的一切都准备好了。
words.en: Everything refers to all things, events, or ideas that are relevant to a particular situation or subject.

words.tr: adj. 活跃的；积极的；主动的；
words.ex: He is an active student in class.
words.ex_cn: 他在课堂上是一个活跃的学生。
words.en: Someone who is active moves around a lot or does a lot of things.

words.ex: He is a reliable friend who always helps.
words.ex_cn: 他是一个可靠的朋友，总是帮忙。
words.en: Able to be trusted to do or provide what is needed or right.

words.tr:
n. 力量；电源；权力；强国；
v. 给…提供能量；供以动力；
words.ex: The power of the storm broke the trees.
words.ex_cn: 风暴的力量折断了树木。
words.en: The ability or capacity to do something or act in a particular way; control or influence over others; electrical energy supplied to a device or building.

words.tr: adj. 无能为力的；无影响力的
words.ex: He felt powerless when he saw the accident.
words.ex_cn: 当他看到事故时，他感到无能为力。
words.en: If someone is powerless to do something, they are completely unable to do it.

words.ex: The entrance to the building is on the left.
words.ex_cn: 这座建筑的入口在左边。
words.en: An entrance is a way into a place, such as a door or gate. It can also refer to the act of entering a place or the right to enter.

words.ex: Children play on the pavement after school.
words.ex_cn: 孩子们放学后在人行道上玩耍。
words.en: A pavement is a path with a hard surface, usually by the side of a road, that people walk on.

words.tr:
v. 注册；登记；
n. 登记簿；
words.ex: He will register for the course next week.
words.ex_cn: 他下周会注册这门课程。
words.en: If you register something, you officially record it or list it.

words.ex: He bought a hot dog from a food booth.
words.ex_cn: 他从一个小吃亭买了个热狗。
words.en: A booth is a small area separated from a larger public area by screens or thin walls where, for example, people can make a phone call or vote in private.

words.ex: The story he told was untrue.
words.ex_cn: 他讲的故事是不真实的。
words.en: If a statement or idea is untrue, it is false and not based on facts.

words.ex: The consumer buys food at the store.
words.ex_cn: 消费者在商店购买食物。
words.en: A consumer is a person who buys goods or uses services.

words.ex: The car consumes a lot of gas.
words.ex_cn: 这辆车消耗很多汽油。
words.en: To consume something means to eat or drink it, or to use it up in some way.

words.ex: The roller coaster gave her a thrill.
words.ex_cn: 过山车让她感到兴奋。
words.en: A thrill is a sudden feeling of great excitement, pleasure, or fear.

words.tr: adj. 非常兴奋的；极为激动的； v. “thrill”的过去式和过去分词；
words.ex: He was thrilled when he won the prize.
words.ex_cn: 当他赢得奖品时，他非常兴奋。
words.en: If someone is thrilled, they are extremely pleased about something.

words.tr: adj. 野生的；狂热的；荒芜的；猛烈的；
words.ex: The lion is a wild animal.
words.ex_cn: 狮子是一种野生动物。
words.en: Living or growing in the natural environment; not domesticated or cultivated.

words.ex: The park protects many kinds of wildlife.
words.ex_cn: 这个公园保护许多种类的野生生物。
words.en: Wildlife refers to animals and plants that live and grow in natural conditions.

words.ex: He drove dangerously fast on the wet road.
words.ex_cn: 他在湿滑的路面上开得非常危险地快。
words.en: In a manner that involves the possibility of danger or risk.

words.ex: The river is dangerous for children.
words.ex_cn: 这条河对孩子来说很危险。
words.en: If something is dangerous, it is able or likely to hurt or harm you.

words.ex: He compare apples and oranges to see which is sweeter.
words.ex_cn: 他比较苹果和橙子，看看哪个更甜。
words.en: If you compare one thing with another, you consider the similarities and differences between them.

words.tr: adj. 可比较的；比得上的；类似的；
words.ex: The prices of these two phones are comparable.
words.ex_cn: 这两部手机的价格是可比较的。
words.en: Something that is comparable to something else is similar in size, amount, or quality.

words.tr:
adj. 第二的；
n. 第二；秒；片刻；
adv. 第二；
words.ex: He got the second prize in the competition.
words.ex_cn: 他在比赛中获得了第二名。
words.en: Second is used to describe something that is next after the first in order, rank, importance, or occurrence.

words.tr:
n. 类型；种类；典型；字体；
v. 打字；
words.ex: This is a new type of phone.
words.ex_cn: 这是一种新型手机。
words.en: A type is a category of things or people that have similar characteristics.

words.ex: She is a fast typist.
words.ex_cn: 她是一位打字很快的打字员。
words.en: A typist is someone who types, especially as their job.

words.ex: The water supply is adequate for the village.
words.ex_cn: 供水对这个村庄来说是足够的。
words.en: If something is adequate, there is enough of it or it is good enough to be used or accepted.

words.ex: The food supply was inadequate for the number of people.
words.ex_cn: 食物供应对人数来说是不充分的。
words.en: If something is inadequate, there is not enough of it or it is not good enough.

words.tr: n. 紧张；紧张局势；紧张关系；
words.ex: There was tension between the two friends after the argument.
words.ex_cn: 两人争吵后，彼此之间出现了紧张。
words.en: Tension is a feeling of worry and anxiety which makes it difficult for you to relax. It can also refer to the state of being stretched tight or the degree of tightness of a stretched string, wire, etc.

words.ex: He avoids eating sugar to stay healthy.
words.ex_cn: 他避免吃糖以保持健康。
words.en: If you avoid something, you take action in order to prevent it from happening to you.

words.ex: He was unfit for the job because he lacked experience.
words.ex_cn: 他因缺乏经验而不合格。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is unfit for a particular purpose or job, you are criticizing them because they are not good enough for that purpose or job.

words.ex: I have an appointment with my doctor at 3 p.m.
words.ex_cn: 我下午三点有个医生的约会。
words.en: An appointment is a formal arrangement to meet or visit someone at a particular time, especially for a purpose connected with their work or official position.

words.tr: v. 喝；喝酒；“drink”的过去分词； adj. 喝醉的；
words.ex: He has drunk all the water.
words.ex_cn: 他喝了所有的水。
words.en: If someone is drunk, they have consumed so much alcohol that it has affected their ability to think and speak clearly.

words.tr: adj. 基本的；基础的；根本的；
words.ex: Water is a fundamental need for life.
words.ex_cn: 水是生命的基本需求。
words.en: You use fundamental to describe things, activities, and principles that are very important or essential. They affect the basic nature of other things or are the most important element upon which other things depend.

words.tr:
n. 皱纹
v. 起皱纹；弄皱…
words.ex: He has a deep wrinkle on his forehead.
words.ex_cn: 他的额头上有一道深深的皱纹。
words.en: A wrinkle is a small line or fold in something, especially fabric or the skin.

words.ex: He learned a new phrase in Spanish.
words.ex_cn: 他学了一个新的西班牙语短语。
words.en: A phrase is a short group of words that people often use as a way of saying something. The meaning of a phrase is often not obvious from the meaning of the individual words in it.

words.ex: The theory of gravity explains why things fall down.
words.ex_cn: 重力理论解释了为什么东西会往下掉。
words.en: A theory is a formal idea or set of ideas that is intended to explain something.

words.tr:
n. 志愿者；
v. 自愿做；
words.ex: He is a volunteer at the local hospital.
words.ex_cn: 他是当地医院的一名志愿者。
words.en: A volunteer is someone who does work without being paid for it, especially work that involves helping people.

words.ex: The balloon went up into the sky.
words.ex_cn: 气球升上了天空。
words.en: toward a higher place or position

words.ex: I cannot foresee what will happen tomorrow.
words.ex_cn: 我无法预知明天会发生什么。
words.en: If you foresee something, you expect and believe that it will happen.

words.tr:
n. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
v. 潜水；跳水；暴跌；
words.ex: He went for a dive in the sea.
words.ex_cn: 他去海里潜水。
words.en: If you dive into water, you jump in head-first with your arms held straight above your head. Dive is also a noun.

words.ex: He gave a summary of the story at the end.
words.ex_cn: 他在结尾对故事做了总结。
words.en: A summary is a brief statement or account of the main points of something.

words.tr:
adj. 正确的；
v. 改正；修正；
words.ex: The answer is correct.
words.ex_cn: 这个答案是正确的。
words.en: If something is correct, it is right and true. If you correct someone, you tell them that they are wrong.

words.tr:
n. 避难所；庇护所；
v. 庇护；遮蔽；
words.ex: The refugees found shelter in a small building.
words.ex_cn: 难民们在一个小建筑里找到了避难所。
words.en: A shelter is a small building or covered place which is made to protect people from bad weather or danger.

words.ex: The judge made a fair decision to show justice.
words.ex_cn: 法官做出了公正的裁决以体现公正。
words.en: Justice is fairness in the way that people are treated.

words.ex: He will finish his homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 他会在晚饭前完成作业。
words.en: To finish something means to reach the end of it or to complete it.

words.ex: The government announced a major reform in education.
words.ex_cn: 政府宣布了教育方面的重大改革。
words.en: If someone reforms a system, they change or improve it.

words.tr:
conj. 也不；也没有；
adv. 也不；也没有；
words.ex: He doesn't like coffee, nor does she.
words.ex_cn: 他不喜欢咖啡，她也不喜欢。
words.en: used before the second or last of a set of negative possibilities, usually after 'neither'

words.ex: Asia is the largest continent.
words.ex_cn: 亚洲是最大的洲。
words.en: A continent is a very large area of land, such as Africa or Asia, that consists of several countries.

words.ex: I felt pity for the lonely child.
words.ex_cn: 我对那个孤独的孩子感到怜悯。
words.en: If you feel pity for someone, you feel very sorry for them.

words.ex: He made an adjustment to live in the new city.
words.ex_cn: 他做出了适应以适应新城市的生活。
words.en: An adjustment is a small change that is made to something such as a machine or a way of doing something.

words.tr:
n. 信用；赊账；赞扬；贷款；荣誉；
v. 相信；
words.ex: He has good credit with the bank.
words.ex_cn: 他在银行有良好的信用。
words.en: If you are allowed credit, you are allowed to pay for goods or services several weeks or months after you have received them.

words.ex: He works hard to earn money.
words.ex_cn: 他努力工作以赚取收入。
words.en: To earn means to gain something, especially money or respect, through your own efforts or work.

words.ex: There is a pile of books on the table.
words.ex_cn: 桌子上有一堆书。
words.en: A pile of things is a quantity of them lying on top of one another. If you pile things somewhere, you put them there so that they form a pile.

words.ex: He left a heap of clothes on the floor.
words.ex_cn: 他把一堆衣服扔在地上。
words.en: A heap of things is a pile of them, especially a pile arranged in a rather untidy way.

words.ex: None of the students passed the test.
words.ex_cn: 没有一个学生通过了考试。
words.en: not any; no amount or part of something

words.tr: v. 增加；引起；筹募；提起；养育；
words.ex: The company will raise wages next month.
words.ex_cn: 公司下个月将提高工资。
words.en: To raise something means to move it to a higher position or to increase it in amount or level.

words.ex: The rain made the road wet.
words.ex_cn: 雨使得道路变湿了。
words.en: To create, produce, or prepare something, especially by putting parts together or by combining materials.

words.ex: He visits a religious temple every Sunday.
words.ex_cn: 他每周日都去一座宗教寺庙。
words.en: Relating to or believing in a religion.

words.tr:
v. 领会；抓紧；
n. 领会；
words.ex: I couldn't grasp the meaning of the poem.
words.ex_cn: 我没能领会这首诗的含义。
words.en: To grasp something means to take it in your hand and hold it firmly.

words.ex: He violated the school rule by using his phone in class.
words.ex_cn: 他上课使用手机，违反了校规。
words.en: If someone violates an agreement, law, or promise, they break it.

words.tr:
n. 欲望；渴望；
v. 渴望；期望；
words.ex: He felt a strong desire to travel the world.
words.ex_cn: 他有一种强烈的环游世界的欲望。
words.en: A strong feeling of wanting to have something or wishing for something to happen.

words.tr: adj. 破旧的；肮脏破烂的；衣衫褴褛的
words.ex: He wore a shabby coat to school.
words.ex_cn: 他穿着一件破旧的外套去学校。
words.en: If you describe something as shabby, you mean that it looks old and is in poor condition.

words.tr:
prep. 到…时；直到…为止；
conj. 到…时；直到…为止；
words.ex: He waited until the bus came.
words.ex_cn: 他一直等到公交车来。
words.en: Up to the time of; before (a specified time).

words.ex: The government made a new regulation to control pollution.
words.ex_cn: 政府出台了一项新管理措施来控制污染。
words.en: A regulation is an official rule or order.

words.ex: Please excuse me for being late.
words.ex_cn: 请原谅我迟到了。
words.en: To excuse someone means to forgive them for something they have done wrong or to allow them not to do something that they should do.

words.tr: n. 全体人员；人事部；职员；
words.ex: The company hired new personnel last month.
words.ex_cn: 这家公司上个月雇佣了新员工。
words.en: The people who are employed in a company or organization.

words.ex: She put jam on her bread for breakfast.
words.ex_cn: 她早餐在面包上涂了果酱。
words.en: Jam is a sweet food made by boiling fruit with sugar until it is thick. It is usually spread on bread or toast. Jam can also refer to a situation where things are crowded or blocked, or the act of forcing something into a tight space.

words.tr: n. 惊险小说（或戏剧、电影）；
words.ex: He loves watching thriller movies at night.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢晚上看惊险电影。
words.en: A thriller is a book, film, or play that tells an exciting story about something such as criminal activities or spying.

words.tr: v. 得到；获得；使；变得；收到；
words.ex: I got a new book from the library.
words.ex_cn: 我从图书馆得到了一本新书。
words.en: To come into possession of something; to receive or be given something.

words.ex: The clown amuses the children with funny tricks.
words.ex_cn: 小丑用滑稽的把戏娱乐孩子们。
words.en: If something amuses you, it makes you want to laugh or smile.

words.tr: adj. 逗人笑的； v. “amuse”的现在分词；
words.ex: The clown gave an amusing performance.
words.ex_cn: 小丑的表演很逗人笑。
words.en: Something that is amusing makes you laugh or smile.

words.ex: It was foolish to walk on the ice.
words.ex_cn: 在冰上走是愚蠢的。
words.en: If you say that someone or something is foolish, you mean that they are not sensible or show a lack of good judgment.

words.ex: He stayed home because of sickness.
words.ex_cn: 他因为生病待在家里。
words.en: A particular illness or disease.

words.ex: The car dealer sold me a new bike.
words.ex_cn: 汽车经销商卖给我一辆新自行车。
words.en: A dealer is a person whose business involves buying and selling things.

words.ex: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.ex_cn: 他是心脏手术方面的专家。
words.en: A specialist is a person who is highly skilled or knowledgeable in a particular field.

words.tr: n. 过错；故障；缺陷；断层；
words.ex: It was his fault that the car crashed.
words.ex_cn: 汽车撞车是他的过错。
words.en: A fault is a mistake or a weakness in something or someone.

words.tr: adj. 有缺陷的；有故障的；有错误的；
words.ex: The faulty phone keeps turning off.
words.ex_cn: 这部有缺陷的手机总是自动关机。
words.en: If you describe something as faulty, you mean that it is not perfect or it has some weaknesses.

words.tr:
adj. 特别的；特殊的；
n. 特价；特色菜；专车；特别的物品；
words.ex: This is a special day for me.
words.ex_cn: 这一天对我来说很特别。
words.en: Something that is special is different from normal things, or is considered to be better than normal things.

words.ex: He felt shame for lying to his mother.
words.ex_cn: 他因为对母亲撒谎而感到羞愧。
words.en: A painful feeling of humiliation or distress caused by the consciousness of wrong or foolish behavior.

words.ex: It is shameful to lie to your friends.
words.ex_cn: 对朋友撒谎是可耻的。
words.en: If you describe someone's behaviour or attitude as shameful, you think that it is so bad that the person ought to be ashamed.

words.tr:
n. 大学毕业生；
v. 毕业；
words.ex: He is a graduate of Harvard University.
words.ex_cn: 他是哈佛大学的毕业生。
words.en: A graduate is a person who has successfully completed a degree at a university or college and has received a certificate or diploma stating this. To graduate means to successfully complete a degree at a university or college.

words.ex: My family came to my graduation.
words.ex_cn: 我的家人来参加我的毕业典礼。
words.en: Graduation is the successful completion of a course of study at a university, college, or school, often marked by a ceremony.

words.tr:
adj. 总的；全部的；
n. 总计；总额；
v. 共计；总数达；
words.ex: The total cost is $50.
words.ex_cn: 总费用是50美元。
words.en: The whole amount or number; the sum total.

words.ex: I totally agree with you.
words.ex_cn: 我完全同意你的观点。
words.en: Used to emphasize that something is completely true or correct.

words.ex: I managed to finish my homework before dinner.
words.ex_cn: 我设法在晚饭前完成了作业。
words.en: To manage means to be in charge of or control something, especially a business or a group of people.

words.ex: Good management helps a company grow.
words.ex_cn: 良好的管理有助于公司发展。
words.en: The control and organization of something, especially a business and its employees.

words.ex: He can describe the picture in one sentence.
words.ex_cn: 他能用一句话描述这幅画。
words.en: If you describe a person, object, event, or situation, you say what they are like or what happened.

words.ex: The teacher gave a clear description of the experiment.
words.ex_cn: 老师对实验做了清晰的描述。
words.en: A description of someone or something is a statement that explains what they are or what they are like.

words.tr:
v. 努力；斗争；挣扎；
n. 努力；斗争；难事；
words.ex: He struggles to finish his homework every night.
words.ex_cn: 他每天晚上都努力完成作业。
words.en: If you struggle to do something, you try hard to do it, even though it is difficult or other people are making it difficult for you.

words.ex: The drawback of this phone is its short battery life.
words.ex_cn: 这款手机的缺点是电池续航时间短。
words.en: A drawback is a feature of something that makes it less useful or desirable than it could be.

words.ex: The water begins to boil at 100 degrees.
words.ex_cn: 水在100度时开始沸腾。
words.en: When a liquid boils or when you boil it, it reaches the temperature at which it starts to turn into a gas.

words.ex: My ancestor came from China a hundred years ago.
words.ex_cn: 我的祖先一百年前来自中国。
words.en: An ancestor is a person from whom one is descended, typically more remote than a grandparent.

words.tr: adj. 强有力的；有影响力的；很有效的；
words.ex: He is a powerful speaker who inspires many.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位强有力的演讲者，激励了很多人。
words.en: A powerful person or thing is able to control or influence people or events.

words.ex: He will vote for the new leader.
words.ex_cn: 他将投票支持新领袖。
words.en: If you vote, you indicate your choice officially at a meeting or in an election, for example by raising your hand or writing on a piece of paper.

words.tr:
adv. 径直；直接；直；
adj. 直的；
words.ex: He walked straight to the door.
words.ex_cn: 他径直走向门。
words.en: extending or moving uniformly in one direction only; without a curve or bend.

words.ex: His words were contradictory.
words.ex_cn: 他的话是矛盾的。
words.en: If two or more facts, ideas, or statements are contradictory, they state or imply that opposite things are true.

words.ex: There is strong competition between the two companies.
words.ex_cn: 这两家公司之间竞争激烈。
words.en: Competition is a situation in which two or more people or groups are trying to get something which not everyone can have.

words.ex: I found a great bargain at the market.
words.ex_cn: 我在市场上找到了一件便宜货。
words.en: A bargain is an agreement between two people or groups in which each promises to do something in exchange for something else. It can also refer to something bought or offered for sale much more cheaply than is usual or expected.

words.tr:
n. 荣誉；荣幸；
v. 尊敬；
words.ex: He received an honour for his brave actions.
words.ex_cn: 他因英勇的行为获得了荣誉。
words.en: Honour is a quality that combines respect, pride, and honesty. It is a measure of a person's reputation and the esteem in which they are held by others.

words.ex: He finally acknowledged his mistake.
words.ex_cn: 他终于承认了自己的错误。
words.en: If you acknowledge a fact or a situation, you accept or admit that it is true or that it exists.

words.ex: He visits his grandparents every fortnight.
words.ex_cn: 他每两周拜访一次祖父母。
words.en: A fortnight is a period of two weeks.

words.ex: The team improved its defense in the second half.
words.ex_cn: 球队在下半场改进了防守。
words.en: The act of defending against attack, danger, or injury.

words.ex: He practises piano every day.
words.ex_cn: 他每天练习钢琴。
words.en: To do something repeatedly in order to improve your skill at it.

words.ex: He bought new clothing for the winter.
words.ex_cn: 他为冬天买了新衣服。
words.en: Clothing refers to items worn on the body. Clothing is typically made of fabrics or textiles but over time has included garments made from animal skin or other thin sheets of materials put together.

words.tr:
n. 影响（力）；
v. 影响；
words.ex: The teacher had a big influence on her students.
words.ex_cn: 老师对学生们有很大的影响。
words.en: The power to affect, control, or manipulate someone or something.

words.ex: The apple's flesh is sweet and juicy.
words.ex_cn: 苹果的果肉又甜又多汁。
words.en: The soft substance consisting of muscle and fat that is found between the skin and bones of an animal or a human.

words.ex: The burglar broke into the house at night.
words.ex_cn: 窃贼在夜里闯入了房子。
words.en: A burglar is a person who illegally enters buildings and steals things.

words.ex: He worked hard and succeeded in the exam.
words.ex_cn: 他努力学习，考试成功了。
words.en: To achieve something that you have been aiming for, or to take over a position or role after someone else.

words.tr:
n. 最小值；
adj. 最小量的；
words.ex: The minimum of the function is 5.
words.ex_cn: 这个函数的最小值是5。
words.en: The minimum is the smallest or least amount possible or allowed.

words.ex: The physician checked the patient's temperature.
words.ex_cn: 医生检查了病人的体温。
words.en: A physician is a medical doctor who is trained in the diagnosis and treatment of diseases and injuries.

words.tr:
prep. 在…上面；
adj. 上述的；
adv. 在上面；
words.ex: The book is above the table.
words.ex_cn: 书在桌子上面。
words.en: In or to a higher place than something else; over.

words.ex: He studies ecology to understand how animals live with plants.
words.ex_cn: 他学习生态学以了解动物如何与植物共存。
words.en: Ecology is the study of the relationships between living organisms, including humans, and their physical environment; it seeks to understand the vital connections between plants and animals and the world around them.

words.tr:
n. 邮件；职位；邮寄；帖子；柱；
v. 邮寄；张贴；
words.ex: I checked the post this morning.
words.ex_cn: 我今天早上检查了邮件。
words.en: To post something means to send it through the postal system or to display it publicly, such as on a noticeboard or the internet. It can also refer to the act of assigning someone to a particular job or position.

words.ex: We had dinner at a buffet with many dishes to choose from.
words.ex_cn: 我们在自助餐吃了晚饭，有很多菜可以选。
words.en: A buffet is a meal consisting of several dishes from which guests serve themselves. As a verb, to buffet means to strike repeatedly and violently.

words.tr:
n. 探究；搜索；
v. 搜索；搜寻；
words.ex: The search for truth took many years.
words.ex_cn: 对真理的探究花了多年时间。
words.en: If you search for something or someone, you look carefully for them because you want to find them.

words.tr:
adj. 在头顶上的；
adv. 在空中；
words.ex: The overhead light is too bright.
words.ex_cn: 头顶上的灯太亮了。
words.en: You use overhead to indicate that something is above you or above the place that you are talking about.

words.ex: The passengers are aboard the plane.
words.ex_cn: 乘客们在飞机上。
words.en: On or onto a ship, aircraft, bus, or train.

words.tr: v. 兑现；递送；交付；发表；为…接生；
words.ex: He promised to deliver on his goal.
words.ex_cn: 他承诺要兑现自己的目标。
words.en: To bring and hand over (a letter, parcel, or ordered goods) to the proper recipient or address.

words.ex: The thunderstorm woke us up at night.
words.ex_cn: 雷雨在夜里把我们吵醒了。
words.en: A thunderstorm is a storm with thunder and lightning and typically also heavy rain or hail.

words.ex: This broken phone is useless.
words.ex_cn: 这部坏掉的手机毫无用处。
words.en: If something is useless, it is not able to do what it is supposed to do or is not effective.

words.tr:
n. 树皮；
v. 狗吠；
words.ex: The dog climbed the tree and touched the bark.
words.ex_cn: 狗爬上了树，摸了摸树皮。
words.en: The sound a dog makes; the outer covering of a tree.

words.tr:
n. 相反；
adj. 相反的；
words.ex: The contrary of hot is cold.
words.ex_cn: 热的相反是冷。
words.en: If you say that something is true contrary to other people's beliefs or opinions, you are emphasizing that it is true and that they are wrong.

words.tr: adj. 西方的；西洋的；西部的；
words.ex: He likes western music and movies.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢西方的音乐和电影。
words.en: Western means relating to the countries of the West, especially Europe and America.

words.tr:
n. 声音；声响；
v. 听起来；
adj. 健全的；合理的；可靠的；
words.ex: I heard a strange sound at night.
words.ex_cn: 我半夜听到了一个奇怪的声音。
words.en: Sound is a vibration that propagates as an acoustic wave, through a transmission medium such as a gas, liquid or solid. In human physiology and psychology, sound is the reception of such waves and their perception by the brain.

words.ex: The choir sings every Sunday in church.
words.ex_cn: 唱诗班每周日在教堂唱歌。
words.en: A choir is a group of people who sing together, especially in a church or school.

words.tr:
n. 力量；力；兵力；武力；
v. 强迫；促使；推动；
words.ex: The force of the wind broke the tree.
words.ex_cn: 风的力量折断了那棵树。
words.en: Force is a physical power or strength possessed by a living being; it is also an influence that can change the motion of an object.

words.ex: He hurt his wrist while playing basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他打篮球时伤了手腕。
words.en: The part of your body where your hand joins your arm.

words.ex: The mother fed her baby with her breast.
words.ex_cn: 母亲用乳房喂养她的婴儿。
words.en: The front part of a person's body between the neck and the stomach, or the similar part on a bird or animal.

words.tr: n. 剃须刀；电动剃须刀
words.ex: He uses an electric shaver every morning.
words.ex_cn: 他每天早上使用电动剃须刀。
words.en: A shaver is a device used for shaving, typically consisting of a handle and a head with one or more blades.

words.ex: He was late because the bus was slow.
words.ex_cn: 他迟到了，因为公交车很慢。
words.en: You use 'because' when stating the reason for something.

words.ex: There is a restriction on smoking in this building.
words.ex_cn: 这栋楼里禁止吸烟。
words.en: A restriction is an official rule that limits what you can do or that limits the amount or size of something.

words.tr: n. 要洗的衣物；洗好的衣物； v. 洗；洗涤；“wash”的现在分词；
words.ex: She put the washing into the machine.
words.ex_cn: 她把要洗的衣物放进洗衣机里。
words.en: The act of cleaning something using water and usually soap or detergent.

words.tr:
n. 毒药；毒物；
v. 毒害；
words.ex: The snake's poison can kill quickly.
words.ex_cn: 蛇的毒药能迅速致死。
words.en: A poison is a substance that causes harm or death if it is swallowed, absorbed, or breathed in. It can also refer to something that has a very harmful effect on something else.

words.ex: The frog is poisonous.
words.ex_cn: 这只青蛙是有毒的。
words.en: Something that is poisonous will kill you or make you ill if you eat it, drink it, or absorb it.

words.tr:
v. 抓住；持有；容纳；保留；举行；
n. 拿；控制；持；
words.ex: He held the rope tightly.
words.ex_cn: 他紧紧抓住了绳子。
words.en: To have or keep in the hand; to maintain in a grasp; to keep in a specified state, relation, or position; to contain or be capable of containing; to have in one's possession; to keep back from action; to delay the action or effect of; to keep in custody; to bear, sustain, or support; to have or maintain in the mind; to consider or esteem; to assert or affirm; to organize and carry on; to have the ownership or use of; to keep from falling or moving; to remain unbroken or unyielding; to remain attached or faithful; to remain valid or effective.

words.tr: n. 持有者；拥有者；支架
words.ex: The holder of the ticket won a prize.
words.ex_cn: 票的持有者中了奖。
words.en: A holder is a person or thing that holds something.

words.tr: n. 优势；有利条件；好处；
words.ex: His height gives him an advantage in basketball.
words.ex_cn: 他的身高在篮球中给了他优势。
words.en: An advantage is a factor or circumstance that puts you in a favorable or superior position.

words.ex: The disadvantage of living far away is long commute time.
words.ex_cn: 住得远的劣势是通勤时间长。
words.en: A disadvantage is a factor which makes someone or something less useful, acceptable, or successful than other people or things.

words.tr: n. 娱乐；消遣；休闲活动
words.ex: Reading books is his favorite recreation.
words.ex_cn: 读书是他最喜欢的消遣。
words.en: Recreation is activity that you do for enjoyment or amusement when you are not working.

words.ex: He enjoys recreational activities like swimming and hiking.
words.ex_cn: 他喜欢游泳和徒步等娱乐活动。
words.en: Relating to or denoting activity done for enjoyment when one is not working.

words.ex: This job requires patience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作需要耐心。
words.en: If you require something, you need it or want it.

words.tr: n. 需求；要求；必要条件；
words.ex: The job has a requirement of two years of experience.
words.ex_cn: 这份工作的要求是两年经验。
words.en: A requirement is something that is necessary or that must be done.

words.ex: He washed his hands to remove the dirt.
words.ex_cn: 他洗手以去除污垢。
words.en: Dirt is any substance that makes something unclean, such as mud or dust.

words.ex: The floor is dirty after the rain.
words.ex_cn: 下雨后，地板变得肮脏了。
words.en: If something is dirty, it is marked or covered with stains, spots, or mud, and needs to be cleaned.

words.ex: I learn English every day.
words.ex_cn: 我每天学习英语。
words.en: To gain knowledge or skill by studying, practicing, being taught, or experiencing something.

words.tr: v. 学习；“learn”的过去式和过去分词； adj. 有学问的；
words.ex: He learned to read when he was five.
words.ex_cn: 他五岁时学会了阅读。
words.en: A learned person has gained a lot of knowledge by studying.

words.ex: He gave a generous donation to the poor.
words.ex_cn: 他慷慨地捐钱给穷人。
words.en: A generous person gives more of something, especially money, than is usual or expected.

words.tr: adv. 慷慨地；宽大地；大量地；充足地
words.ex: She generously gave her friend some money.
words.ex_cn: 她慷慨地给了朋友一些钱。
words.en: In a way that shows a readiness to give more of something, especially money, than is strictly necessary or expected.

words.tr:
adj. 犯罪的；
n. 罪犯；
words.ex: He made a criminal mistake by stealing money.
words.ex_cn: 他偷钱犯了一个犯罪的错误。
words.en: A criminal is a person who has committed a crime.

words.tr: n. 刑事学家;犯罪学家
words.ex: The criminalist analyzed the evidence to solve the case.
words.ex_cn: 刑事学家分析证据以解决案件。
words.en: A criminalist is a specialist in the scientific study and analysis of crime and criminals.

words.ex: He is a successful businessman.
words.ex_cn: 他是一位成功的商人。
words.en: Achieving the results wanted or hoped for.

words.ex: He completed the task successfully.
words.ex_cn: 他成功地完成了任务。
words.en: In a way that accomplishes a desired aim or result.

words.ex: The crowd applauded after the performance.
words.ex_cn: 演出结束后，观众鼓掌了。
words.en: To applaud means to show approval or praise by clapping the hands.

words.ex: He left the room immediately after the bell rang.
words.ex_cn: 铃声一响，他就立即离开了房间。
words.en: If something happens immediately, it happens without any delay.

words.ex: He parked his car in the garage.
words.ex_cn: 他把车停在了车库里。
words.en: A garage is a building where you keep a car. It can also refer to a place where cars are repaired.

words.ex: The politician gave a speech about education.
words.ex_cn: 这位政治家就教育问题发表了一次演讲。
words.en: A politician is a person who is professionally involved in politics, especially as a holder of or a candidate for an elected office.

words.ex: He walked sideways to avoid the puddle.
words.ex_cn: 他斜着走以避开水坑。
words.en: Moving or directed toward one side.

words.tr: adv. 仅仅；就；只是；刚刚；恰好；
words.ex: He just wants to sleep.
words.ex_cn: 他仅仅想睡觉。
words.en: Used to indicate that something is exactly the case or is happening at this moment.

words.tr: adj. 讨厌的；令人厌烦的
words.ex: The long meeting was tiresome.
words.ex_cn: 这场漫长的会议很讨厌。
words.en: If you describe someone or something as tiresome, you mean that you find them irritating or boring.

words.tr:
adv. 好；对；满意地；
int. （用于表示惊讶，疑虑，接受等）好；
n. 井；
adj. 健康的；
words.ex: She sings well.
words.ex_cn: 她唱得很好。
